title: Q-Arbor Interface Schema
description: Stable product interface contract for Q-Arbor identity-bound artifacts.

x-invariants: manifest_sha256 identifies the immutable canonical manifest for exactly this split without exposing hidden paths, rows, labels or seeds.
Hash canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators after removing contract_hash.
development.role=development and development.sealed=false
gate.role=gate and gate.sealed=true
final.role=final, final.sealed=true, final.query_budget=1
No secret, credential, or hidden split filesystem path is serialized into the contract.
Editable and protected path sets must be disjoint after glob normalization.
id, parent_id, depth, created_event_id and dispatched hypothesis fields are immutable.
attempt_id identifies an execution attempt; it is never reused after interruption.
score is a read-only materialized projection of admissible referenced EvaluationResult objects; no actor may assign it directly.
Contaminated evidence cannot propagate as an active insight.
The tree is a materialized view at ledger_head; it is never the append-only history source.
children, counts, scores and current statuses are deterministic projections of verified records.
Mutation requires expected revision and an idempotency key; the event is durable before the tree snapshot changes.
An attempt_id is never reused; retry creates a new attempt and retains the terminal predecessor.
Dispatch and prompt snapshot records are durable before the external executor starts.

Replaying a durable response may reuse one logical evaluation request without new data access; restarting an evaluator requires a new request and query budget, and final cannot restart after consumption.
The redacted prompt fields are the exact bytes sent to the model after deterministic normalization.
Capability tokens, secrets, raw gate or final locators, seeds and data never appear in the snapshot.
Executor dispatch snapshots contain development evaluation material only.
Denied, failed, duplicate and scoreless requests remain represented according to the frozen selection and duplicate policies.
Candidate family labels and semantic similarity do not establish statistical independence or effective trial count.
Changing membership or method assumptions creates a new snapshot and invalidates dependent diagnostics.
split_manifest_hash equals the selected QuantResearchContract SplitSpec.manifest_sha256 before authorization.
Each method has its own required assumptions; a generic valid-p-value flag is insufficient.
claim_level=controlled requires every required assumption to pass and an independently frozen confirmation design.
Risk flags and diagnostics do not assert a new control theorem.
status=success requires all mandatory provenance hashes and hard checks to pass.
provenance.split_manifest_hash equals the EvaluationRequest split_manifest_hash and the selected contract SplitSpec.manifest_sha256.
A final result is terminal and cannot be fed back into propose, dispatch, or adaptive evaluate actions.
Raw gate/final data cannot appear in result artifacts or free-form output.
Raw capability tokens are never serialized, logged, or injected into LLM prompts.
executor principal is development-only; finalizer is final-only.
A final grant has query_limit=1 and becomes consumed after one terminal request.
Hash canonical event content excluding event_hash; sequence=1 has prev_event_hash=null.
Every proposal, validation, evaluation allow/deny/result, failure, retry, merge, prune, unlock and stop is durable before the next state transition.
The chain is tamper-evident inside the local harness threat model; it does not resist an administrator replacing every artifact and anchor.
Checkpoint write is atomic, but semantic completeness comes from writing ledger dispatch/start events before external work.
On resume, ledger is authoritative; dangling attempts become interrupted and any retry receives a new attempt_id.
Tree and messages hashes must match the artifact references before replay.
Reports are generated from research_head and a fixed reporter; report.generated may advance the package ledger head without changing research facts.
integrity_status=pass requires an empty missing_artifacts array and all identity-critical artifact hashes to verify.
final_state=sealed_unopened is an expected state and is not a missing artifact.
selected_candidate may be null only with an explicit no-valid-candidate or equivalent terminal decision.

validate.output: validation receipt + canonical hash + family evidence + list[CheckResult]

replay.output: tree, budgets, capability state, run summary

attempt: completed|failed|denied|interrupted are terminal for that attempt_id
interrupted -> new attempt_id or node stop
